name: file_upload_api_failure
description: Upload limits the rule engine only partly sees. The first model call fails (rate limit): the interview must continue with the built-in questions, and the next call must work again.
requirements:
REQ-1: The user can upload a profile photo.
REQ-2: The maximum file size is 5 MB.
REQ-3: Uploaded photos should appear quickly in the profile.
REQ-4: Only JPG and PNG files are accepted; other formats are rejected with an error message.
REQ-5: The user enters a caption of up to 200 characters.

issues.note: what the user sees after an upload

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-1.value: The new photo is shown on the profile page.

rule.ambiguous_wording.REQ-3.value: The photo appears within 3 seconds after the upload finishes.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-5.value: A caption longer than 200 characters cannot be saved and an error is shown.

answers_by_text.value: The upload is rejected with the message that the file is too large.

questions.question: What happens when the user uploads a file larger than the maximum size?
questions.reason: The boundary test for REQ-2 needs the expected outcome.

test_cases.title: Unsupported format is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: The file is rejected with an error message.

test_cases.title: Too large file is rejected
steps: Upload a file just over the maximum size
test_cases.expected_result: The upload is rejected with the message that the file is too large.
